badge.name: Interactive Web Pages
badge.description: Recognizes the named activity after instructor review at the confirmed threshold.

criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M7A5 (Make Your Portfolio Interactive).

Award threshold: 75%.

m7a5: Make Your Portfolio Interactive. Added JavaScript behavior to a live portfolio. The assessment covered an array of original content, a loop that renders it, a function that returns a result, an event listener that changes the displayed data and sensible handling of empty or unusual input.
